pre_fit_amendment.reason: Label-blind forward/backward pilots found batch128 within366MiB peak allocated and approximately doubled relational throughput versus32; preserve v1 source snapshots/artifacts and lock v2 before classifier fitting
unchanged: five outer and three inner folds

scope: Adaptive development on the existing 4977 centers only; no protected evaluation data

input_contract.source: Verified P3 long V-JEPA cache, with exact entire P0 short tensor fallback for all 467 invalid long rows
input_contract.times: Midpoints in seconds of each source-frame pair forming a tubelet; timestamps read from verified manifests
input_contract.quality_features: Same six audited geometry/validity features from memory_data for every arm
input_contract.root_motion: No unaudited scene-root estimator; crop-grid matching displacement is not physical root velocity
input_contract.feature_scaling: Per-channel mean/std pooled across time and region on current training rows only; quality scaled on training rows only
input_contract.first_order_features: Same per-region time means and labeled-center-containing tubelet features for every arm
input_contract.time_kernel: Positive learned gain conditioned on both edge durations and inter-edge physical lag; averaging denominator contains observation support only so the gain does not cancel on uniform grids; no division of feature changes by elapsed seconds
input_contract.correspondence: Local adjacent-grid soft matches with unmatched option; subtract static self-matching to make unchanged grids yield zero residual; region cells are not anatomical joints

batch_size_policy: Fixed128 for every arm after label-blind resource pilot and before first classifier fit; no changes after v2 locking
selection: Pooled inner best-checkpoint macro-F1 descending, NLL ascending, learning-rate ascending, weight-decay ascending
outer_refit_epochs: Rounded median of selected configuration's three best inner epochs, at least one

post_fit_system.fusion: For every arm, arithmetic probability mean of all three outer seeds; standalone plus fixed 0.5 expert +0.5 P6
post_fit_system.read_policy: Read P6 only after every declared arm/fold fit is complete; never supply historical predictions to fitting or hyperparameter selection

statistics.multiplicity: Holm over exactly five directional development contrasts

inference_diagnostics.interpretation: Fixed inference stress tests, not separately trained causal controls; center tubelet remains slot4
